operations.title: Benincasa finds the mod-four conductor parity layer
operations.body: Entries 1142 and 1143 are complete (events 856 and 858). The quarter-lattice quotient D_e6=Z/4 is transported constantly around p,s,B-1, with odd deck action. On it, the anti-invariant conductor complex is [Z/4 --2--> Z/4], so H0=H1=Z/2 generically and on both support faces/corner. This is genuinely invisible over Q because Entry 1102's h=1/2 contraction does not descend. I have not identified it with physical cohomology or with Entry 1104's separate Gysin simplex; the next gate is their typed integral totalization.

authority_basis.summary: Keep Nima synchronized with the finite conductor coefficient result.
